title: The Space Ship
lines: Jane and Ben make a space ship.
They use a big box and lots of tape.
A flat place on the grass is best.
Ben has a big grin on his face.
They race up and hop in the box.
The ship is not fast. It is a box.
But in space, a box is fine!

questions.ask: What do Jane and Ben use to make the ship?
questions.listenFor: A big box and lots of tape. Both are in the same line.

questions.ask: Does the ship really fly? How do you know?
questions.listenFor: No — the story says it is not fast, it is a box. Let them find the line.

questions.ask: Where would you fly a box ship? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Any answer with a reason is right. This one is just for talking.
